profiles_role_clinic_check.name: profiles_role_clinic_check
profiles_role_clinic_check.value: ("profiles"."role" = 'super_admin' AND "profiles"."clinic_id" IS NULL) OR ("profiles"."role" <> 'super_admin' AND "profiles"."clinic_id" IS NOT NULL)

clinic_holidays_window_chk.name: clinic_holidays_window_chk
clinic_holidays_window_chk.value: ("clinic_holidays"."start_time" IS NULL) = ("clinic_holidays"."end_time" IS NULL) AND ("clinic_holidays"."end_time" IS NULL OR "clinic_holidays"."end_time" > "clinic_holidays"."start_time")

outbox_temporal_chk.name: outbox_temporal_chk
outbox_temporal_chk.value:
("outbox"."processing_started_at" IS NULL OR "outbox"."processing_started_at" >= "outbox"."created_at")
       AND ("outbox"."processed_at" IS NULL OR "outbox"."processed_at" >= "outbox"."created_at")
       AND ("outbox"."first_failed_at" IS NULL OR "outbox"."first_failed_at" >= "outbox"."created_at")
       AND ("outbox"."last_failed_at" IS NULL OR "outbox"."last_failed_at" >= "outbox"."created_at")
       AND ("outbox"."first_failed_at" IS NULL OR "outbox"."last_failed_at" IS NULL OR "outbox"."last_failed_at" >= "outbox"."first_failed_at")
